import os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
    d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv')
    d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    px[s]=d['close'].astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# One interpretable candidate: reverse recent return after penalising downside risk.
# Higher score = recent losers with less upside/downside noise, intended defensive reversal.
look=20
down=R.clip(upper=0).rolling(look,min_periods=15).std()
ret=P.pct_change(look)
F=-(ret/(down*np.sqrt(252)+1e-12))
# Winsorize cross section to limit crypto/outlier domination
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=downside_vol_scaled_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
    fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1
    vals=[]; dates=[]; nobs=[]
    for dt in F.index:
        a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(a)>=8:
            vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); nobs.append(len(a))
    x=np.array(vals,float); x=x[np.isfinite(x)]
    mean=x.mean(); sd=x.std(ddof=1); icir=mean/sd*np.sqrt(252) if sd else np.nan
    # daily paper ICIR convention used by miner is mean/std (not annualized); report both
    print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',np.mean(nobs),'coverage',np.mean(nobs)/len(U),'IC',mean,'ICIR_daily',mean/sd,'ICIR_ann',icir,'hit',np.mean(x>0),'sd',sd)
    for label, lo, hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-10-17'),('recent','2028-10-18','2029-10-17')]:
        z=np.array([v for v,d in zip(vals,dates) if pd.Timestamp(lo)<=d<=pd.Timestamp(hi)],float); z=z[np.isfinite(z)]
        print(' ',label,len(z),round(float(z.mean()),6) if len(z) else None,round(float(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)),6) if len(z)>1 and z.std(ddof=1)>0 else None)
# turnover rank changes and coverage
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)).dropna()
print('turnover_rank_abs_change',turn.mean(),'valid_coverage',F.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(U))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-11-14']; R=P.pct_change()
# Defensive trend quality: medium-term trend scaled by realized risk and path noise.
look=60; vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252); ret=P.pct_change(look)
path=(R.abs().rolling(look,min_periods=45).sum()+1e-12); efficiency=ret.abs()/path
F=(ret/(vol+1e-12))*efficiency
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=defensive_trend_quality; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.array(vals,float); ok=np.isfinite(x); x=x[ok]; ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)[ok]; sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4),'sd',round(sd,6))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-11-14'),('recent','2028-11-15','2029-11-14')]:
  z=x[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(hi))]; zs=z.std(ddof=1)
  print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover_rank_abs_change',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
# save reproducible artifact for downstream provenance
out=F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291115_defensive_trend_quality_10d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-11-28']; R=P.pct_change()
# Volatility-transition momentum: medium-term return favored when recent volatility is
# contracting, with a bounded transition multiplier to avoid extreme crypto shocks.
r20=P.pct_change(20); v5=R.rolling(5,min_periods=4).std(); v40=R.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()
transition=(v40/(v5+1e-12)).clip(0.5,2.0)
F=(r20*transition).clip(lower=None)
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=volatility_transition_momentum; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.array(vals,float); ok=np.isfinite(x); x=x[ok]; ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)[ok]; sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4),'sd',round(sd,6))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-11-28'),('recent','2028-11-29','2029-11-28')]:
  z=x[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(hi))]; zs=z.std(ddof=1)
  print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover_rank_abs_change',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
out=F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291129_volatility_transition_momentum_10d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-12-12']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
# Relative dispersion reversal: fade asset-specific 10-session shocks, but scale by its own risk and
# emphasize shocks that are large relative to the contemporaneous cross-asset distribution.
r10=P.pct_change(10); med=r10.median(axis=1); mad=(r10.sub(med,axis=0).abs().median(axis=1)+1e-8)
F=-(r10.sub(med,axis=0)/mad)/(vol*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)
# bounded tails for robustness
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=dispersion_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.array(vals,float); ok=np.isfinite(x); x=x[ok]; ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)[ok]; sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(np.mean(np.array(ns)[ok]),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(np.array(ns)[ok])/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-12-12'),('recent','2028-12-13','2029-12-12')]:
  z=x[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(hi))]; zs=z.std(ddof=1)
  print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover_rank_abs_change',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
out=F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291213_dispersion_reversal_10d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-12-12']; R=P.pct_change(); vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
r10=P.pct_change(10); med=r10.median(axis=1); mad=(r10.subtract(med,axis='index').abs().median(axis=1)+1e-8)
F=r10.subtract(med,axis='index').div(mad,axis='index').div(vol*np.sqrt(20)+1e-8)
F=-F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=dispersion_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.array(vals,float); ok=np.isfinite(x); x=x[ok]; ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)[ok]; ns=np.array(ns)[ok]; sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(ns.mean(),2),'coverage',round(ns.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-12-12'),('recent','2028-12-13','2029-12-12')]:
  z=x[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(hi))]; zs=z.std(ddof=1)
  print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover_rank_abs_change',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
out=F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291213_dispersion_reversal_10d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv'); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); px[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2029-12-26']; R=P.pct_change()
# Tail-resilience reversal: fade 40d losses, but penalize assets whose downside volatility is elevated.
r40=P.pct_change(40); down=R.where(R<0).rolling(60,min_periods=30).std(); total=R.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()
resilience=(r40/(down*np.sqrt(60)+1e-8))
# cross-sectional rank, with low downside-risk quality tilt; winsorize robustly
F=-resilience
F=F.clip(lower=F.quantile(.05,axis=1),upper=F.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('candidate=tail_resilience_reversal; universe',len(U),'dates',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40]:
 fr=P.shift(-h).div(P)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in F.index:
  a=pd.concat([F.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(a))
 x=np.array(vals,float); ok=np.isfinite(x); x=x[ok]; ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)[ok]; ns=np.array(ns)[ok]; sd=x.std(ddof=1)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(ns.mean(),2),'coverage',round(ns.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/sd,6),'hit',round(np.mean(x>0),4))
 for label,lo,hi in [('early','2020-01-01','2022-12-31'),('mid','2023-01-01','2026-07-15'),('online','2026-07-16','2029-12-26'),('recent','2028-12-27','2029-12-26')]:
  z=x[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(lo))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(hi))]; zs=z.std(ddof=1)
  print(' ',label,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6) if len(z) else None,'ICIR',round(z.mean()/zs,6) if len(z)>1 and zs else None,'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4) if len(z) else None)
rank=F.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover_rank_abs_change',round(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6),'valid_coverage',round(F.notna().mean().mean(),6))
out=F.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20291227_tail_resilience_40d_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2029-12-27

### Explored Factors

1. **Tail-Resilience Reversal**
   - Construction: negative 40-session return divided by 60-session downside volatility, with cross-sectional 5th–95th percentile winsorization.
   - Motivation: identify assets with persistent losses relative to their downside risk and test medium-horizon reversal.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20291227_tail_resilience_40d_signal.csv`

2. **Relative-Volatility 20d Reversal**
   - Construction: negative 20-session return divided by 20-session annualized realized volatility, with cross-sectional winsorization.
   - Motivation: favor assets with unusually poor risk-adjusted recent performance.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20291227_relative_vol_reversal_10d_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

#### Tail-Resilience Reversal

The candidate had limited historical coverage because the downside-volatility dependency was unavailable for many assets during the early sample.

| Horizon | Eligible dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Result |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 5d | 524 | 9.56 | 63.74% | +0.078699 | +0.226591 | Insufficient broad-history coverage |
| 10d | 519 | 9.57 | 63.79% | +0.080181 | +0.238054 | Not admitted |
| 20d | 509 | 9.54 | 63.58% | +0.110247 | +0.344410 | Not admitted |
| 40d | 489 | 9.51 | 63.41% | +0.137994 | +0.419550 | Not admitted |

The online-only 10d result was strong, with IC **+0.080181** and ICIR **+0.238054**, but the candidate did not provide adequate multi-regime history. The early and mid-regime observations were effectively absent, so the result was not considered robust enough for persistence.

#### Relative-Volatility 20d Reversal

| Horizon | Eligible dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Result |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 5d | 1,513 | 13.97 | 93.11% | +0.020247 | +0.063095 | Failed ICIR gate |
| 10d | 1,510 | 13.91 | 92.75% | **+0.016175** | **+0.051520** | Failed ICIR gate |
| 20d | 1,822 | 13.73 | 91.53% | −0.002348 | −0.007184 | Failed |
| 40d | 1,495 | 13.94 | 92.91% | +0.052927 | +0.162713 | Not admitted at required 10d horizon |

The required 10-session admission thresholds were:

- Absolute IC ≥ **0.0070**
- Absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**

Although the relative-volatility reversal showed strong online performance at 10d—IC **+0.066824**, ICIR **+0.243217**—its full-history ICIR failed the benchmark gate. Historical regime splits were also inconsistent: early and mid-sample 10d ICs were negative, while the online regime was positive.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- No candidate satisfied the required robustness and admission criteria.
- `memory.txt` was updated with the research results and rejection rationale.

### Current Effective Factors

Existing effective factors remain unchanged, including:

- `miner_3_20291129_inverse_trend_quality_10d`
- `miner_3_20291213_dispersion_reversal_10d`
- Other previously admitted library factors subject to correlation audits and ongoing revalidation.

No new factor was added this cycle.

### Plans

- Revalidate the relative-volatility reversal after additional online observations accumulate.
- Test versions with longer volatility histories or volatility shrinkage to improve early-sample coverage.
- Investigate whether the strong recent reversal effect is conditional on cross-asset breadth, stress, or macro-regime indicators.
- Avoid persisting highly correlated reversal variants without deterministic library-correlation evidence.

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Candidate: short-term reversal gated by broad market stress/trend; score is negative 5d return, amplified when breadth is weak.
r5=p.pct_change(5); r20=p.pct_change(20)
breadth=(r20>0).sum(axis=1)/r20.notna().sum(axis=1)
stress=(1-breadth).clip(0,1)
f=(-r5).mul(0.5+stress,axis=0)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20]:
  fr=f.shift(1); fw=p.shift(-h)/p-1
  vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
  for dt in p.index:
    x=fr.loc[dt]; y=fw.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
      ic=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
      if np.isfinite(ic): vals.append(ic); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
  a=np.array(vals); print(h,'dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,4),'IC',round(np.mean(a),6),'ICIR',round(np.mean(a)/(np.std(a,ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4),'turnover',round(np.mean((f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1)).dropna()),4))
# save 10d signal artifact
out=pd.DataFrame(f,columns=U); out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300110_breadth_conditioned_reversal_10d_signal.csv')
print('range',p.index.min(),p.index.max())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-03-21')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r5=p.pct_change(5); r20=p.pct_change(20); r60=p.pct_change(60)
vol20=p.pct_change().rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Contrarian trend break: reverse recent 20d excess versus prior 60d average, scaled by own risk.
raw=-(r20-r60/3.0)/(vol20+1e-12)
sig=raw.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 for name,sl in [('early',a.loc[:'2023-12-31']),('middle',a.loc['2024-01-01':'2026-12-31']),('late',a.loc['2027-01-01':])]:
  print(' ',name,len(sl),round(sl.ic.mean(),6) if len(sl) else None,round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6) if len(sl)>1 else None)
out=sig; out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300321_trendbreak_volscaled_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-04-18')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change()
# Path asymmetry: fraction of positive sessions minus fraction of negative sessions,
# scaled by absolute cumulative return; contrarian signal, lagged one day.
pos=(r>0).rolling(20).mean(); neg=(r<0).rolling(20).mean()
r20=p.pct_change(20)
raw=-(pos-neg)*(r20.abs()+0.01)
sig=raw.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-05-02')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); med=r.median(axis=1)
# Relative trend, confirmed by breadth: asset 40d relative return is scaled by
# the contemporaneous fraction of assets with positive 10d returns. Lag one day.
rel=(r.sub(med,axis=0)).rolling(40,min_periods=30).sum()
breadth=(r.rolling(10,min_periods=8).sum()>0).mean(axis=1)
# centered breadth preserves direction while emphasizing broad confirmation
confirm=2*breadth-1
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
f=(rel/(vol+1e-8)*confirm).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==40:
  for name,sl in [('2020-2023',a[a.date<='2023-12-31']),('2024-2026',a[(a.date>='2024-01-01')&(a.date<='2026-12-31')]),('2027-2030',a[a.date>='2027-01-01'])]:
   print(name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))
f.index.name='date'; f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300502_breadth_confirmed_relative_trend_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-05-16')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].rename(s) for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); med=r.median(axis=1)
# Compression-breakout: relative 20d trend, inverse recent volatility, activated by a positive cross-asset breadth regime.
rel=r.sub(med,axis=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
vol5=r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).std(); vol40=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()
compression=(vol5/vol40).clip(0.25,2.0)
breadth=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()>0).mean(axis=1)
regime=(breadth-0.5)*2
f=rel.div(vol40+1e-8).div(compression,axis=0).mul(regime,axis=0).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==40:
  for name,sl in [('2020-2023',a[a.date<='2023-12-31']),('2024-2026',a[(a.date>='2024-01-01')&(a.date<='2026-12-31')]),('2027-2030',a[a.date>='2027-01-01'])]:
   print(name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))
f.index.name='date'; f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300516_compression_breakout_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2030-05-30')
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].rename(s) for s in U}
p=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index().loc[:end]
r=p.pct_change(); med=r.median(axis=1)
# Trend consistency: relative 20d return, multiplied by fraction of positive sessions,
# and volatility-normalized; all inputs lagged one day.
rel=r.sub(med,axis=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
cons=(r>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()-0.5
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()
f=rel.div(vol+1e-8).mul(1+cons,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 y=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]
 for dt in p.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append((dt,q,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'avg_n',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(a.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.ic.mean()/(a.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((a.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h in [40,60]:
  for name,sl in [('2020-2023',a[a.date<='2023-12-31']),('2024-2026',a[(a.date>='2024-01-01')&(a.date<='2026-12-31')]),('2027-2030',a[a.date>='2027-01-01'])]:
   print('regime',h,name,'dates',len(sl),'IC',round(sl.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(sl.ic.mean()/(sl.ic.std(ddof=1)+1e-12),6),'hit',round((sl.ic>0).mean(),4))
# mean absolute rank movement as a turnover proxy on consecutive valid dates
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna()
print('turnover_proxy',round(turn.mean(),6),'turnover_dates',len(turn))
f.index.name='date'; f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20300530_trend_consistency_signal.csv')

### Explored Factors

- **Breadth-Confirmed Risk-Adjusted Trend**
  - Constructed as 60-day return divided by 40-day annualized volatility.
  - Applied a cross-sectional breadth gate based on the proportion of assets with positive 20-day returns.
  - The direct trend version was tested first but showed persistently negative predictive IC.
- **Breadth-Confirmed Risk-Adjusted Trend Reversal**
  - Inverted the trend signal after observing the failed direct-trend formulation.
  - Signal is lagged one completed session to avoid lookahead.
  - Uses all 15 tradable benchmark instruments and requires at least 8 valid assets per IC date.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 10d | 1,300 | 14.28 | 95.19% | 0.077071 | 0.237372 | 61.00% |

The selected 60-day factor passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Required absolute IC: 0.0070
- Required absolute ICIR: 0.0840
- Observed IC: **0.209077**
- Observed ICIR: **0.680007**
- Valid dates: **978**
- Average cross-section: **14.95**
- Coverage: **99.67%**
- Turnover proxy: **0.161421**

Regime results:

- **2024–2026:** 118 dates, IC **0.340211**, ICIR **1.117374**
- **2027–2030:** 860 dates, IC **0.191085**, ICIR **0.629280**

The direct trend variant failed, with 60-day IC **−0.209077** and ICIR **−0.680007**. Its inverse therefore produced the effective contrarian formulation. The positive relationship persisted across both tested regimes, though uncertainty remains material given the 15-instrument cross-section.

- `factors/miner_3_20300711_breadth_confirmed_trend_reversal_60d.json`
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20300711_breadth_confirmed_trend_signal.csv`

- Prefer the new factor as a potential diversification candidate only if its realized signal correlation is acceptably low.

   - Signal: \(\frac{\text{40-day downside movement}}{\text{40-day absolute movement}}\), lagged one session.
   - Motivation: test whether persistent downside pressure creates a medium-horizon mean-reversion opportunity.
   - Evaluated across all 15 tradable instruments, requiring at least 8 valid instruments per date.

- Required absolute IC: 0.0070
- Required absolute ICIR: 0.0840
- Observed IC: 0.042191
- Observed ICIR: 0.124145

- **2024–2026:** 483 dates, IC 0.035621, ICIR 0.108210

Turnover proxy was low at **0.057414**.

The factor is highly redundant with the explored inverse formulation and showed a maximum absolute artifact correlation of **1.0**. This should be treated as a provenance and ensemble-redundancy warning rather than independent diversification evidence.

- `factors/miner_3_20300808_downside_pressure_40d.json`

   - Signal: negative deviation of each asset’s 20-day realized volatility from the cross-sectional median volatility, lagged by one session.

The aggregate result is positive, but the factor is materially regime-dependent and has recently shown no predictive power in 2030 YTD. The low turnover proxy of **0.018234** is favorable, but the small cross-section and unstable regime behavior warrant conservative use and prompt revalidation.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
close={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4000)
    if d is not None and len(d)>150:
        x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); close[s]=x.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(close).sort_index().ffill()
r=p.pct_change()
# Relative-strength factor: 60d return relative to contemporaneous cross-sectional median,
# scaled by 20d realized volatility. Lagged one day to avoid lookahead.
ret60=p/p.shift(60)-1
rel=ret60.sub(ret60.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol20=r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(rel/vol20).shift(1)
# forward simple returns; cross-sectional IC by date
out=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
    fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1
    vals=[]; dates=[]; counts=[]
    for dt in f.index:
        a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(a)>=8 and a.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and a.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
            vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); counts.append(len(a))
    z=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.to_datetime(dates)).dropna()
    ic=z.mean(); icir=ic/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(z)) if len(z)>1 else np.nan
    print({'horizon':h,'dates':len(z),'avg_n':round(float(np.mean(counts)),2),'IC':round(float(ic),6),'ICIR':round(float(icir),6),'hit':round(float((z>0).mean()),4),'coverage':round(float(np.mean(counts)/len(U)),4)})
# regime diagnostics for 20d

for dt in f.index:

 if len(a)>=8 and a.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and a.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1: vals.append((dt,a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'),len(a)))
z=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
for name,lo,hi in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030YTD','2030-01-01','2030-10-16')]:
 q=z.loc[lo:hi].ic; print({'regime':name,'dates':len(q),'IC':round(float(q.mean()),6) if len(q) else None,'ICIR':round(float(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(q)),6) if len(q)>1 else np.nan,6) if len(q) else None})

     \frac{R_{20d}}{\sigma_{30d}}\times(0.5+\text{cross-sectional breadth})

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cl, hi, lo = {}, {}, {}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d):
  q=d[['date','close','high','low']].copy(); q.date=pd.to_datetime(q.date); q=q.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
  cl[s]=q.close.astype(float); hi[s]=q.high.astype(float); lo[s]=q.low.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(cl).sort_index(); H=pd.DataFrame(hi).reindex(p.index); L=pd.DataFrame(lo).reindex(p.index)
r=p.pct_change(); r20=p.pct_change(20); vol=r.rolling(30).std()
# Recent true range relative to its 90-day baseline; stressed markets receive stronger contrarian weight.
range20=((H-L)/p).rolling(20).mean(); range90=range20.rolling(90).median()
stress=(range20/range90).clip(0.5,2.0)
f=(-r20/vol * stress).shift(1)
allz={}
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; counts=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8 and a.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and a.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); counts.append(len(a))
 z=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.to_datetime(dates)).dropna(); allz[h]=z
 print(f'h={h} dates={len(z)} avgN={np.mean(counts):.2f} coverage={np.mean(counts)/len(U):.4f} IC={z.mean():.6f} ICIR={z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(z)):.6f} hit={np.mean(z>0):.4f}')
z=allz[20]
for lo_,hi_,nm in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31','2024-26'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31','2027-29'),('2030-01-01','2030-11-27','2030YTD')]:
 q=z.loc[lo_:hi_]; print(f'regime={nm} dates={len(q)} IC={q.mean():.6f} ICIR={q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(len(q)) if len(q)>1 else np.nan:.6f}')
print(f'loaded={len(cl)} dates={len(p)} avgN={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean():.2f} turnover={f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean():.6f}')
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20301128_range_stressed_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>200: D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
# signal: medium trend adjusted by volatility, amplified after compressed ranges; lag 1 day
close=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); hi=pd.DataFrame({s:d.high for s,d in D.items()}); lo=pd.DataFrame({s:d.low for s,d in D.items()})
r=close.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(30).std(); nr=(hi-lo)/close
compression=nr.rolling(20).mean()/nr.rolling(90).median()
# breakout continuation: 40d risk-adjusted trend, only when recent range is compressed
sig=(r.rolling(40).sum()/vol.replace(0,np.nan))*((1.5-compression).clip(.25,1.5))
sig=sig.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(close.index)-h):
  dt=close.index[i]; nxt=close.index[i+h]
  x=sig.iloc[i]; y=close.iloc[i+h]/close.iloc[i]-1
  z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==60:
  for name,a,b in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31')]:
   q2=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',name,len(q2),round(q2.ic.mean(),6),round(q2.ic.mean()/q2.ic.std(),6))
  # turnover rank changes
  ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('TURN',round(ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
# provenance artifact
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20301212_range_compression_breakout_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150: D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
close=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); hi=pd.DataFrame({s:d.high for s,d in D.items()}); lo=pd.DataFrame({s:d.low for s,d in D.items()})
r=close.pct_change(); v=r.rolling(20).std()
# Contrarian location in the prior 60-session high-low envelope, risk scaled and lagged.
mx=close.rolling(60).max(); mn=close.rolling(60).min()
loc=((close-mn)/(mx-mn).replace(0,np.nan)-0.5)
sig=(-loc/v.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(close.index)-h):
  x=sig.iloc[i]; y=close.iloc[i+h]/close.iloc[i]-1
  z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append((close.index[i],z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for name,a,b in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31')]:
   q2=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',name,len(q2),round(q2.ic.mean(),6),round(q2.mean().ic/q2.ic.std(),6))
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20301226_range_position_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150: D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
close=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()})
r=close.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20).std()
# Relative 20-session performance versus the contemporaneous cross-asset median.
# Reverses idiosyncratic relative winners and favors relative losers, risk scaled and lagged.
ret20=close/close.shift(20)-1
relative=ret20.sub(ret20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
sig=(-relative/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(close.index)-h):
  z=pd.concat([sig.iloc[i],close.iloc[i+h]/close.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append((close.index[i],z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for name,a,b in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31')]:
   q2=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',name,len(q2),round(q2.ic.mean(),6),round(q2.ic.mean()/q2.ic.std(),6),round((q2.ic>0).mean(),4))
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310109_cross_sectional_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000) for s in U}; D={s:d.set_index('date').sort_index() for s,d in D.items() if d is not None and len(d)>180}
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); r=c.pct_change(); v=r.rolling(60).std()
# Contrarian long-gap: favor assets whose recent 20d return trails their 120d trend,
# normalized by medium-term volatility. Lag one completed session.
sig=((c.pct_change(20)-c.pct_change(120))/v).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 out=[]
 for i in range(len(c)-h):
  z=pd.concat([sig.iloc[i],c.iloc[i+h]/c.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: out.append((c.index[i],z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for nm,a,b in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',nm,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(),6) if len(x)>1 else None,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else None)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310206_long_gap_volscaled_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150: D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
close=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}); r=close.pct_change()
# Persistence factor: medium-horizon directional efficiency, rewarding positive
# net movement with small downside participation. Lagged one completed session.
win=60
up=r.clip(lower=0).rolling(win).sum(); down=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(win).sum()
net=close.pct_change(win)
path=(r.abs().rolling(win).sum()).replace(0,np.nan)
sig=((net/path) * (up/(down+up).replace(0,np.nan))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(close.index)-h):
  z=pd.concat([sig.iloc[i],close.iloc[i+h]/close.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append((close.index[i],z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/len(U),4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for name,a,b in [('2024-2026','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-2029','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   q2=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',name,len(q2),round(q2.ic.mean(),6),round(q2.ic.mean()/q2.ic.std(),6) if len(q2)>1 else np.nan,round((q2.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(q2) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310220_upside_downside_persistence_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(close))

summary:
### Step Summary — 2031-05-01

- **Historical context:** The previously effective volume-confirmed reversal factor had strong full-history results but negative 2031 YTD IC, while recent ensemble performance had been unstable. The current five-factor ensemble improved live performance modestly (+0.15% over 10 days) but still has weak backtest quality and requires diversification.
- **New factor explored:** Cross-asset dispersion-conditioned, volatility-adjusted reversal across the complete 15-instrument universe. The signal uses lagged negative 15-day return divided by 20-day annualized volatility, amplified by unusually high trailing 20-day cross-sectional return dispersion normalized over 120 days.
- **Implementation flow:**
  1. Created `scripts/miner_3_20310501_dispersion_conditioned_reversal.py`.
  2. Initial run failed because `Rolling.std(axis=1)` is unsupported; corrected the calculation to use cross-sectional `r.std(axis=1)`.
  3. A second issue produced no validation dates because the common dispersion multiplier was not broadcast across asset columns; corrected it with an explicit aligned DataFrame.
  4. Re-ran validation successfully and generated `scripts/miner_3_20310501_dispersion_conditioned_reversal_signal.csv`.
- **Validation results:** At the 20-day horizon, IC **+0.079890**, ICIR **+0.275067**, hit ratio **63.78%**, turnover **0.067813**, 1,212 valid dates, and full 15-asset coverage. IC strengthened through longer horizons, reaching **+0.142351 at 60 days**.
- **Regime context:** Performance remained positive in all periods: 2024–2026 IC **+0.146851**, 2027–2029 **+0.068438**, 2030 **+0.095396**, and 2031 YTD **+0.049773**. The 2031 result is weaker but no longer negative, which is favorable relative to the prior reversal factor.
- **Persistence:** Saved as `factors/miner_3_20310501_dispersion_conditioned_reversal_20d.json` with status **EFFECTIVE**, including formula, parameters, validation metrics, universe, and provenance. Library-correlation auditing remains pending because `max_abs_library_correlation` is still `null`.
- **Next decision:** Run deterministic pairwise correlation and ensemble-redundancy checks before adding meaningful exposure; monitor whether the positive but weakening 2031 regime persists.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>180:D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index(); r=c.pct_change()
# medium-term momentum, risk scaled; breadth gate rewards continuation when cross-asset participation is broad
mom=c.pct_change(20); vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
breadth=(mom>0).mean(axis=1)
gate=((breadth-0.5)*2).clip(-1,1)
sig=(mom/(vol+1e-12)).mul(1+0.5*gate,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=c.shift(-h)/c-1; a=[]
 for dt in c.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for n,a1,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a1)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',n,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310529_breadth_gated_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2031-05-29

### Explored Factors

**Breadth-gated risk-adjusted momentum**

- Base signal: 20-day cross-asset momentum divided by 40-day annualized volatility.
- Cross-sectional signal was adjusted by market breadth, defined as the fraction of instruments with positive 20-day returns.
- Signals were lagged by one session to avoid look-ahead bias.
- Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
- Signal artifact generated at:
  `scripts/miner_3_20310529_breadth_gated_momentum_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 2,356 | 14.06 | 93.75% | -0.015752 | -0.047709 | 47.84% |
| 10d | 2,102 | 14.02 | 93.45% | -0.026066 | -0.079818 | 44.81% |
| **20d** | **2,562** | **14.01** | **93.43%** | **-0.008534** | **-0.024674** | **45.71%** |
| 40d | 2,311 | 14.06 | 93.70% | -0.038572 | -0.113987 | 43.49% |
| 60d | 2,058 | 14.07 | 93.79% | -0.077144 | -0.227488 | 39.89% |

The 20-day admission horizon failed both benchmark gates:

- Required absolute IC: `>= 0.0070`; observed `0.008534` in absolute terms, but with an undesirable negative direction.
- Required absolute ICIR: `>= 0.0840`; observed `0.024674`, below the gate.
- Turnover proxy: `0.123857`.

Regime results at the 20-day horizon were unstable:

- 2024–2026: IC `+0.049491`, ICIR `+0.124823`
- 2027–2029: IC `-0.072594`, ICIR `-0.252011`
- 2030: IC `-0.110953`, ICIR `-0.381852`
- 2031 YTD: IC `+0.001403`, ICIR `+0.004138`

The factor’s positive early-period result reversed materially in later regimes, indicating significant performance drift.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factor persisted.**
- The candidate failed the ICIR admission threshold and showed unstable regime behavior.
- No factor was marked effective or added to the library.

### Current Effective Factors

Existing effective factor records remain unchanged. The library includes effective signals spanning:

- Risk-adjusted and relative momentum
- Range- and efficiency-based reversal
- Downside-stability reversal
- Breadth-conditioned duration/reversal
- Volatility- and liquidity-adjusted reversal
- Defensive trend quality

Previously persisted signal artifacts and validation records remain available for deterministic ensemble and correlation audits.

### Plans

- Investigate whether breadth gating should be applied to reversal rather than momentum, given the strong negative medium- and long-horizon results.
- Test asymmetric breadth measures that distinguish advancing breadth from stressed downside breadth.
- Explore lower-turnover combinations using 40–60-day signals, while validating separately across 2027–2029, 2030, and 2031 regimes.
- Continue monitoring existing effective factors for recent drift, especially factors whose 2031 YTD ICIR has weakened.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>180:D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index(); r=c.pct_change()
# Reversal of recent acceleration: assets whose latest 5d move is unusually adverse
r5=c.pct_change(5); r20=c.pct_change(20)
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
acc=(r5-r20/4)/(vol+1e-12)
# contrarian acceleration, modestly anchored by medium-term reversal
sig=(-acc-0.25*r20/(vol+1e-12)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=c.shift(-h)/c-1; a=[]
 for dt in c.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==20:
  for n,a1,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a1)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',n,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310612_acceleration_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>220:D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index(); r=c.pct_change()
# Recovery-quality reversal: favor assets with deep 120d drawdowns only when short trend has stabilized.
# Drawdown supplies contrarian value; 20d return and volatility penalize falling knives.
peak=c.rolling(120,min_periods=60).max(); dd=c/peak-1
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
trend=c.pct_change(20)/(vol+1e-12)
# positive stabilization gate, lagged to prevent lookahead
sig=(dd/(vol+1e-12) * (1/(1+np.exp(-2*trend)))).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=c.shift(-h)/c-1; a=[]
 for dt in c.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n'])
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avg_n',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,4),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
 if h==60:
  for n,a1,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
   x=q[(q.date>=a1)&(q.date<=b)]; print('REG',n,len(x),round(x.ic.mean(),6),round(x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(x)>1 else np.nan,round((x.ic>0).mean(),4) if len(x) else np.nan)
  print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310626_recovery_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

        if len(a)>=8: rows.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]))
    z=pd.Series(rows).dropna(); print(f'H={h} dates={len(z)} avgN={np.nanmean([len(pd.concat([sig.loc[d],f.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()) for d in sig.index if len(pd.concat([sig.loc[d],f.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna())>=8]):.2f} IC={z.mean():.6f} ICIR={(z.mean()/z.std() if z.std() else np.nan):.6f} hit={(z>0).mean():.4f}')

# regimes at 60
h=60; f=P.shift(-h)/P-1
for name,lo,hi in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
 z=[]
 for dt in sig.loc[lo:hi].index:
  a=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],f.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8:z.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1]))
 z=pd.Series(z).dropna();print(name,len(z),z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std() if len(z)>1 else np.nan,(z>0).mean())
# save artifact for possible persistence

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2031-09-04

### Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-asymmetry-conditioned cross-asset contrarian reversal**

     \[
     -(\text{asset 20d return} - \text{cross-sectional mean 20d return})

     \frac{\text{downside semivolatility}_{20d}}
     {\text{upside semivolatility}_{20d}}

   - The signal was lagged by one session to avoid look-ahead.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
    d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=3000)
    if d is not None and len(d)>260: D[s]=d.set_index('date').sort_index()
c=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index()
r=np.log(c).diff()
# Volatility-shock recovery: contrarian residual 20d return, amplified when short-run vol
# has sharply exceeded its medium-run baseline. All inputs are lagged one session.
r20=c.pct_change(20); resid=r20-r20.mean(axis=1)
vol5=r.rolling(5,min_periods=4).std(); vol60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
shock=(vol5/(vol60+1e-10)).clip(0,8)
shock_rank=shock.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
sig=(-resid*(0.5+shock_rank)).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
    fwd=c.shift(-h)/c-1; a=[]
    for dt in c.index:
        z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: a.append((dt,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]),len(z)))
    x=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['date','ic','n']); ic=x.ic
    print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avg_n',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/len(D),4),'IC',round(ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(ic.mean()/ic.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((ic>0).mean(),4))
    if h==60:
        for n,a1,b1 in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-12-31')]:
            y=x[(x.date>=a1)&(x.date<=b1)]
            print('REG',n,'dates',len(y),'IC',round(y.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(y.ic.mean()/y.ic.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((y.ic>0).mean(),4))
        print('TURN',round(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),6))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']
out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310918_volatility_shock_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)
print('UNIVERSE',len(D),'DATES',len(c),'SIGNAL_ROWS',len(out))

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2031-09-18

### Explored Factor

Tested **volatility-shock recovery asymmetry**, designed as a potentially more orthogonal alternative to the existing reversal cluster:

\[
-\text{20d cross-asset residual return}
\times
\left(0.5+\text{cross-sectional percentile rank}
\left(\frac{\text{5d volatility}}{\text{60d volatility}}\right)\right)
\]

- Contrarian residual-return component was lagged by one session.
- Volatility shock was defined as short-term realized volatility relative to its 60-day baseline.
- Shock ratio was clipped to `[0, 8]`.
- Universe: 15 benchmark instruments.
- Minimum cross-sectional validity: 8 instruments per date.

### Validation Results

An initial implementation produced zero valid observations because source date indexes were inconsistently typed and the residual subtraction was not explicitly axis-aligned. Dates were normalized to `datetime`, and the cross-sectional subtraction was corrected before rerunning.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data, get_index_daily_data

UNIV=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

def fetch(s):
    for fn in (get_stock_daily_data,get_index_daily_data):
        try:
            x=fn(symbol=s, days=5000)
            if x is not None and len(x)>300: return x[['date','close']].copy()
        except Exception: pass
    return None

def main():
    px={s:fetch(s) for s in UNIV}; px={s:x for s,x in px.items() if x is not None}
    close=pd.concat([x.set_index('date')['close'].rename(s) for s,x in px.items()],axis=1).sort_index().ffill()
    lr=np.log(close).diff()
    # Aligned trend: medium-term return, confirmed by long-term direction,
    # normalized by recent volatility; lagged naturally by using t signal for t+forward.
    r20=close/close.shift(20)-1
    r60=close/close.shift(60)-1
    vol20=lr.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    sig=(r20*np.sign(r60)/vol20).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
    # require alignment, otherwise neutral rather than forcing a direction
    sig=sig.where(np.sign(r20)==np.sign(r60),0.0)
    rows=[]
    for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
        fwd=close.shift(-h)/close-1
        vals=[]
        for d in sig.index:
            z=pd.concat([sig.loc[d],fwd.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
            if len(z)>=8: vals.append((d,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'),len(z)))
        q=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
        ic=q.ic
        rows.append((h,len(q),q.n.mean(),ic.mean(),ic.std(ddof=1),ic.mean()/ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if ic.std(ddof=1)>0 else np.nan,(ic>0).mean()))
    print('assets',len(px),'dates',len(close),'range',close.index.min(),close.index.max())
    print('horizon dates avg_n IC ICIR_daily_annualized hit')
    for x in rows: print('%d %d %.2f %+.6f %+.6f %+.6f %.4f'%x)
    # explicit daily paper ICIR convention annualized sqrt(252), and regime blocks at selected 20d horizon
    h=20; fwd=close.shift(-h)/close-1; vals=[]
    for d in sig.index:
        z=pd.concat([sig.loc[d],fwd.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: vals.append((d,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'),len(z)))
    q=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
    for name,a,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031YTD','2031-01-01','2031-10-02')]:
        u=q.loc[a:b,'ic']; print('regime',name,len(u),u.mean(),u.mean()/u.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if len(u)>2 and u.std(ddof=1)>0 else np.nan)
    # turnover of cross-sectional rank weights, and coverage
    ranks=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); ch=ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)
    print('coverage',sig.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover_proxy',ch.dropna().mean())

if __name__=='__main__': main()

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data,get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def get(s):
 for f in (get_stock_daily_data,get_index_daily_data):
  try:
   x=f(symbol=s,days=5000)
   if x is not None and len(x)>300:return x[['date','close']]
  except:pass
 return None
p={s:get(s) for s in U};p={s:x for s,x in p.items() if x is not None}
c=pd.concat([x.set_index('date').close.rename(s) for s,x in p.items()],axis=1).sort_index().ffill(); lr=np.log(c).diff()
# Shock-recovery: recent selloff is more likely to mean-revert when short vol is unusually elevated.
vol5=lr.rolling(5).std(); vol60=lr.rolling(60).std(); shock=(vol5/vol60).clip(0.5,3)
r5=c/c.shift(5)-1
sig=(-r5*shock).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 f=c.shift(-h)/c-1; a=[]
 for d in sig.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[d],f.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:a.append((d,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'),len(z)))
 q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['d','ic','n']).set_index('d'); x=q.ic
 rows.append((h,len(x),q.n.mean(),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252), (x>0).mean()))
print('assets',len(p),'dates',len(c),'range',c.index.min(),c.index.max())
print('h dates n IC ICIR hit');[print('%d %d %.2f %+.6f %+.6f %.4f'%r) for r in rows]
h=20;f=c.shift(-h)/c-1;a=[]
for d in sig.index:
 z=pd.concat([sig.loc[d],f.loc[d]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:a.append((d,z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'),len(z)))
q=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['d','ic','n']).set_index('d')
for nm,a,b in [('2024-26','2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-29','2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031','2031-01-01','2031-10-15')]:
 x=q.loc[a:b].ic;print('regime',nm,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if x.std()>0 else np.nan)
print('coverage',sig.notna().mean().mean(),'turnover',sig.rank(pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20311016_volshock_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date');print('artifact scripts/miner_3_20311016_volshock_reversal_signal.csv')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Risk-adjusted medium-term momentum: 60d return divided by 20d realized vol,
# lagged one session. Cross-sectional rank is not used in calculation.
series={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4200)
    if d is not None and len(d)>300:
        x=d[['date','close']].copy().dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
        series[s]=x
p=pd.DataFrame(series).sort_index()
r=np.log(p).diff()
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
raw=p.pct_change(60)/vol
f=raw.shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
    fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1
    vals=[]
    for dt in f.index:
        a=f.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]
        z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
            vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
    q=pd.Series(vals).dropna()
    print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(len(U)*0+0,2),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
# metrics at 20d, plus regime summaries
h=20; fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
    z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
        vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
q=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.to_datetime(dates)); print('DETAIL valid_dates',len(q),'avg_instruments',np.mean(ns),'coverage',np.mean(ns)/len(U),'turnover_proxy',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2031-11-12')]:
 z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20311113_risk_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}; H={}; L={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4200)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close','high','low']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=d.close.astype(float); H[s]=d.high.astype(float); L[s]=d.low.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); hi=pd.DataFrame(H).reindex(p.index); lo=pd.DataFrame(L).reindex(p.index)
r=np.log(p).diff()
# Range-stress reversal: contrarian medium-term return, amplified when recent true range is elevated.
tr=(hi-lo)/p
stress=tr.rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean()/(tr.rolling(80,min_periods=40).mean()+1e-12)
ret20=p.pct_change(20)
f=(-ret20*stress).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2031-12-24')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
  print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Downside-volatility reversal: contrarian 20d return, amplified by the share of
# recent 40d realized variance generated on down days. Lag one completed session.
down=r.where(r<0,0.0)
tot=(r**2).rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean()
dn=(down**2).rolling(40,min_periods=20).mean()
frac=(dn/(tot+1e-12)).clip(0,1)
f=(-p.pct_change(20)*(0.75+frac)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-01-07')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
  print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320108_downside_vol_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Relative momentum: asset 60-session return minus contemporaneous cross-asset median,
# scaled by its 40-session realized volatility. Signal is lagged one session.
raw=p.pct_change(60); cross=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(cross/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-01-21')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
  print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320122_relative_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Idiosyncratic short-horizon reversal: remove the contemporaneous cross-asset
# median return from each asset's 10-session return, then volatility-normalize.
# The one-session shift ensures only completed data are used.
r10=p.pct_change(10); cs=r10.median(axis=1)
rv=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(-(r10.sub(cs,axis=0))/(rv+1e-12)).shift(1)
print('UNIVERSE',len(C),'dates',len(p), 'assets',sorted(C))
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-02-04')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320205_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date'); C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change(); r20=p.pct_change(20)
cs=r20.median(axis=1); resid=r20.sub(cs,axis=0)
# Contrarian residual, amplified only when cross-sectional opportunity set is dispersed.
disp=resid.abs().median(axis=1)
base=disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).rank(pct=True)
gate=(0.5+base).clip(0.5,1.5)
rv=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(-resid/(rv+1e-12)).mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
print('UNIVERSE',len(C),'DATES',len(p),'assets',sorted(C))
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-02-18')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  C[s]=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change(); r60=p.pct_change(60)
# Tail-shock reversal: 60d relative performance, scaled by the frequency/intensity of negative daily shocks.
med=r60.median(axis=1); resid=r60.sub(med,axis=0)
down=r.where(r<0,0.0)
downvol=down.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
shock=(down.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=10).mean())
# Robust cross-sectional clipping prevents a single crypto shock dominating.
f=(-resid/(downvol+1e-12))*(1+shock/((r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean())+1e-12)).clip(lower=0.5,upper=2.0)
f=f.shift(1)
print('UNIVERSE',len(C),'DATES',len(p),'assets',sorted(C))
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-03-03')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320304_tailshock_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

{"read_file": "import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date'); C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change(); r20=p.pct_change(20)
cs=r20.median(axis=1); resid=r20.sub(cs,axis=0)
# Contrarian residual, amplified only when cross-sectional opportunity set is dispersed.
disp=resid.abs().median(axis=1)
base=disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).rank(pct=True)
gate=(0.5+base).clip(0.5,1.5)
rv=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(-resid/(rv+1e-12)).mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
print('UNIVERSE',len(C),'DATES',len(p),'assets',sorted(C))
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-02-18')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320219_dispersion_gated_residual_signal.csv',index=False)
"}
