import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4400)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Recovery-conviction reversal: contrarian 20d loss, scaled by distance below 60d high
# and by the fraction of recent up days, which favors assets beginning to recover.
ret20=p/p.shift(20)-1
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
dd=p/p.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()-1
up=r.gt(0).rolling(20,min_periods=14).mean()
# positive signal = expected rebound; lag all observable components one session
f=((-ret20/(vol+1e-8))*(1+(-dd).clip(0,0.35))* (0.5+up)).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-03-17')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
  print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320318_recovery_conviction_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Dual-horizon reversal: fade the 20d relative shock, but only when the
# 5d move confirms a turn against the 60d trend; scale by downside risk.
ret20=p/p.shift(20)-1; ret5=p/p.shift(5)-1; ret60=p/p.shift(60)-1
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std(); down=r.where(r<0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
# positive means rebound: negative medium shock, with short-term turn and risk normalization
turn=ret5-ret60/12.0
f=((-ret20/(down+vol+1e-8))* (1+turn.clip(-0.25,0.25))).shift(1)
rows={}
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna(); rows[h]=q
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-03-31')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320401_dual_horizon_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  x=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=x.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Contrarian medium-term relative return, strengthened only for assets well below their own 120d peak.
rel20=p.pct_change(20).sub(p.pct_change(20).median(axis=1),axis=0)
high120=p.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max()
dd=(p/high120-1).clip(-0.6,0)
stress=(1+(-dd).clip(0,0.6)).clip(1,1.6)
f=(-rel20*stress).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==20:
  for a,b in [('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-04-28')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]; print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320429_drawdown_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  x=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  C[s]=x.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); rets=p.pct_change()
# Contrarian relative 20d return, amplified by persistent drawdown duration (fraction of prior 60 sessions below peak).
peak=p.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max(); dd=(p/peak-1).clip(-0.7,0)
below=(p < peak).astype(float)
duration=below.rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean()
rel20=rets.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum().sub(rets.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum().median(axis=1),axis=0)
# Duration is bounded and only adds up to 50%; signal lagged one completed day.
f=(-rel20*(1+0.5*duration)*(1+(-dd).clip(0,0.7))).shift(1)
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==60:
  for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-05-12')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]
   if len(z): print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320513_drawdown_duration_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={};V={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  x=d[['date','close','volume']].dropna(subset=['date','close']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  P[s]=x.close.astype(float)
  V[s]=x.volume.astype(float).replace(0,np.nan)
p=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); v=pd.DataFrame(V).reindex(p.index)
r=p.pct_change()
# Relative 20-session reversal, amplified only by unusual but bounded volume shock; all inputs lagged one session.
rel20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum(); rel20=rel20.sub(rel20.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
vs=(v.rolling(20,min_periods=12).mean()/v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean()-1).clip(-0.5,1.0)
f=((-rel20/vol.replace(0,np.nan))*(1+0.35*vs.clip(lower=0))).shift(1)
print('DATA dates',len(p),'instruments',len(P),'range',p.index.min(),p.index.max())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[];ns=[];ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==60:
  for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-07-07')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]
   if len(z): print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320708_volume_shock_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
close={}; loc={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4600)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  d=d[['date','close','high','low']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  close[s]=d.close.astype(float)
  rng=(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)
  # Close location value: positive means persistent buying pressure within daily ranges.
  loc[s]=((2*d.close-d.high-d.low)/rng).clip(-1,1)
p=pd.DataFrame(close).sort_index(); l=pd.DataFrame(loc).reindex(p.index); r=p.pct_change()
# Contrarian 40d signed range pressure, scaled by realized volatility; one-day lag.
pressure=l.rolling(40,min_periods=30).mean()
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(-pressure/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
print('DATA dates',len(p),'instruments',len(close),'range',p.index.min(),p.index.max())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[];ns=[];ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==60:
  for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-08-04')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]
   if len(z): print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320805_range_pressure_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

     {(\sum_{i=1}^{40}|r_i|+10^{-8})(\sigma_{40}\sqrt{252}+0.05)}

## Explored Factors

1. **Short-versus-long reversal acceleration**
   - Construction: negative 20-day return relative to half the 60-day return, scaled by 60-day annualized volatility and lagged one completed session.
   - Motivation: identify assets with recent short-term weakness relative to their medium-term path.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Result: reversal orientation was not supported.

2. **Macro-conditioned volatility-scaled reversal**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \frac{-R_{60}}{\sigma_{60}\sqrt{252}+0.05}
     \times \left(1+0.35\tanh(\text{VIX z-score}_{252})\right)
     \times \left(1-0.15\tanh(R^{DXY}_{20})\right)
     \]
   - VIX and DXY are lagged observation-only macro inputs; no orders are placed for them.
   - Motivation: increase reversal exposure during elevated-stress regimes while moderating the signal according to DXY trend.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.

## Validation Results

Data covered **2020-01-01 through 2033-02-02**, using 15 instruments and at least 8 valid instruments per IC date.

### Short-versus-long reversal acceleration

| Horizon | Valid dates | Average instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 10d | 1,669 | 15.00 | -0.022077 | -0.078295 | 46.79% |
| 20d | 1,659 | 15.00 | -0.037551 | -0.131198 | 43.94% |
| 40d | 1,639 | 15.00 | -0.038756 | -0.132412 | 44.54% |
| 60d | 1,619 | 15.00 | -0.024434 | -0.081655 | 45.09% |

Coverage was **48.64%** and turnover was **0.058707**. The factor failed the benchmark admission gates and was not persisted.

### Macro-conditioned volatility-scaled reversal

| Horizon | Valid dates | Average instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 10d | 1,671 | 14.99 | +0.093659 | +0.324823 | 62.42% |

| 40d | 1,641 | 14.99 | +0.192855 | +0.638785 | 75.56% |
| 60d | 1,621 | 14.99 | **+0.214859** | **+0.735032** | **77.85%** |

Additional metrics:

- Coverage: **48.6774%**
- Turnover: **0.037860**
- Average instruments per date: **14.99**
- Maximum absolute library correlation: **null**, pending deterministic signal-artifact audit
- Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20330203_macro_conditioned_reversal_signal.csv`

Recent regime results at the 60-day horizon remained positive:

- 2024: IC **+0.404073**, ICIR **+1.304790**
- 2027–2029: IC **+0.157781**, ICIR **+0.533234**
- 2030: IC **+0.311510**, ICIR **+1.269590**
- 2031–2032: IC **+0.218976**, ICIR **+0.788810**

The factor passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: **0.214859 ≥ 0.0070**
- Absolute ICIR: **0.735032 ≥ 0.0840**

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and reload-verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20330203_macro_conditioned_reversal_60d.json`
- Status: **EFFECTIVE**
- Validation date: **2033-02-03**
- Signal artifact and provenance fields included
- Observation-only macro inputs explicitly documented

The failed short-versus-long reversal acceleration factor was not persisted.

## Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **miner_3_20330203_macro_conditioned_reversal_60d**
  - 60-day IC: **+0.214859**
  - ICIR: **+0.735032**

  - Coverage: **48.68%**
  - Turnover: **0.037860**
  - Valid IC dates: **1,621**
  - Latest validation: **2033-02-03**

Previously persisted effective factors remain subject to independent revalidation and deterministic library-correlation auditing.

## Plans

- Compare the new macro-conditioned signal artifact against the existing recovery and drawdown-reversal cluster.
- Measure incremental predictive value after residualizing against existing volatility-scaled reversal factors.
- Monitor whether the strong stress-conditioned reversal relationship persists in the latest 2033 observations.
- Explore a simpler macro regime interaction to test whether the improvement comes primarily from VIX conditioning or DXY moderation.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4800)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300: px[s]=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
ret10=p.pct_change(10); ret20=p.pct_change(20); ret5=p.pct_change(5)
vol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
peak120=p.rolling(120,min_periods=80).max(); dd=(p/peak120-1).clip(-0.8,0)
# Contrarian loss, weighted toward deep drawdowns; recovery acceleration rewards improving last-10d return.
acc=(ret10-ret20/2).clip(-0.20,0.20)
base=(-ret20/(vol20+0.05))*(1+0.80*(-dd)).clip(lower=0)
confirm=(1+0.75*acc).clip(0.85,1.15)
f=(base*confirm).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('DATA dates',len(p),'instruments',len(px),'range',p.index.min(),p.index.max())
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[];ns=[];ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H %d dates %d avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(h,len(q),np.mean(ns),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==60:
  for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2033-05-11')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]
   if len(z): print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20330512_asymmetric_recovery_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300: px[s]=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
ret5=p.pct_change(5); ret20=p.pct_change(20)
v10=r.rolling(10,min_periods=8).std()*np.sqrt(252); v60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Reversal is strongest after an idiosyncratic short shock, scaled by volatility expansion,
# while the cross-sectional median shock gates broad panic days. All inputs lagged one day.
shock=(-ret5/(v10+0.05)).clip(-4,4)
expansion=(v10/(v60+0.05)-1).clip(-0.8,2.0)
breadth=(ret5.lt(0).mean(axis=1)-0.5).abs() # intensity of one-sided cross-sectional move
f=(shock*(1+0.8*expansion)*(1+0.35*breadth)).shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('DATA dates',len(p),'instruments',len(px),'range',p.index.min(),p.index.max())
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[];ns=[];ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'));ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H %d dates %d avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(h,len(q),np.mean(ns),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==60:
  for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2033-05-25')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]
   if len(z): print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))

confirm=(1+0.75*acc).clip(0.85,1.15)

 if h==60:

print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))

   - Added a modest 10-day recovery confirmation multiplier.
   - Clipped extremes and lagged the final signal by one session to avoid look-ahead bias.
   - Used all 15 tradable instruments and required at least 8 valid instruments per date.

## Validation Results

**Validation date:** 2033-07-07  
**Data period:** 2020-01-01 through 2033-07-06

The negative 2033 YTD result is a significant recent-drift warning.

## Explored Factors

### 1. Volume-confirmed risk-adjusted momentum

- Construction: 60-day cumulative return divided by annualized 60-day volatility.
- Relative volume confirmation uses \(\log(\text{20-day average volume}/\text{120-day average volume})\), clipped to \([-1,1]\).
- Signal is multiplied by \(1+0.30\) times the volume confirmation term, clipped to \([-5,5]\), and lagged one session.
- Motivation: test whether elevated trading activity confirms medium-term trends.

### 2. Volume-confirmed risk-adjusted reversal

- Construction: negative 60-day cumulative return divided by annualized 60-day volatility, with the same relative-volume adjustment.
- Signal is clipped to \([-5,5]\) and lagged one session.
- Motivation: determine whether abnormal volume strengthens the medium-term reversal effect.

## Validation Results

**Validation date:** 2033-08-18  
**Data period:** 2020-01-01 through 2033-08-17  
**Universe:** 15 tradable instruments  
**Average valid cross-section:** 9.0 instruments  
**No observation-only macro instruments were traded or included as tradable assets.**

The momentum formulation failed directionally and was rejected. The reversal formulation passed the benchmark admission gates:

- \(|IC| = 0.200758 \ge 0.0070\)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cl={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>300:
  x=d[['date','close']].dropna().drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
  cl[s]=x.close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(cl).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Peer-relative reversal: remove the contemporaneous cross-asset median trend,
# then fade each asset's 60-session residual move, scaled by idiosyncratic risk.
peer=r.median(axis=1)
resid=r.sub(peer,axis=0)
resid_trend=resid.rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum()
idio=resid.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=(-resid_trend/(idio+0.05)).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
print('DATA dates',len(p),'instruments',len(cl),'range',p.index.min(),p.index.max())
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fr=p.shift(-h)/p-1; qs=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1 and z.iloc[:,1].nunique()>1:
   qs.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(z)); ds.append(dt)
 q=pd.Series(qs,index=pd.to_datetime(ds)).dropna()
 print('H %d dates %d avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(h,len(q),np.mean(ns),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==60:
  for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2026-12-31'),('2027-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2033-08-31')]:
   z=q.loc[a:b]
   if len(z): print('REGIME',a[:4],len(z),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(z.mean(),z.mean()/z.std(),(z>0).mean()))
print('COVERAGE %.6f TURNOVER %.6f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index();out.columns=['date','symbol','signal'];out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20330901_peer_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

   - Lagged one session.

   - Same residual-reversal construction, but activates only when 20-day cross-asset dispersion exceeds its trailing 252-session 60th percentile.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_index_daily_data(s,5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
ret=cl.pct_change()
# one-day lagged, medium-term contrarian signal, scaled by range position:
# fade 60d return; emphasize assets near lower end of their 120d rolling range
r60=cl.pct_change(60)
vol=ret.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
lo=cl.rolling(120).min(); hi=cl.rolling(120).max()
pos=(cl-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)
sig=((-r60/(vol+0.05))*(1.0+0.75*(0.5-pos))).shift(1)
# winsorize cross-section per date
sig=sig.clip(-5,5)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
    fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1
    vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
    for dt in sig.index:
        a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
        if ok.sum()>=8:
            vals.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(ok.sum())
    x=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)).dropna()
    rows.append((h,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1), (x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for z in rows: print('H',z[0],'dates',z[1],'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%z[2:])
# coverage and rank turnover
cov=sig.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U)
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'% (cov.mean(),turn))
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
    fwd=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1; xs=[]
    for dt in sig.index[mask]:
        ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
        if ok.sum()>=8: xs.append(sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman'))
    xs=pd.Series(xs).dropna(); print(name,'dates',len(xs),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(xs.mean(),xs.mean()/xs.std(ddof=1), (xs>0).mean()) if len(xs)>1 else 'insufficient')
# save signal artifact for reproducibility
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20331013_range_position_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
ret=cl.pct_change(); r60=cl.pct_change(60); vol=ret.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Longer regime-aware range: emphasize medium-term losers near the bottom of 180d range.
lo=cl.rolling(180).min(); hi=cl.rolling(180).max(); pos=(cl-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)
sig=((-r60/(vol+0.05))*(1.0+0.75*(0.5-pos))).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok],method='spearman')); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); rows.append((h,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for z in rows: print('H',z[0],'dates',z[1],'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%z[2:])
cov=sig.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U); turn=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(); print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(cov.mean(),turn))
fwd=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
 xs=[]
 for dt in sig.index[mask]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: xs.append(sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman'))
 x=pd.Series(xs).dropna(); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()) if len(x)>1 else 'insufficient')
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20331027_adaptive_range_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
ret=cl.pct_change()
# one-day lagged, medium-term contrarian signal, scaled by range position:
# fade 60d return; emphasize assets near lower end of their 120d rolling range
r60=cl.pct_change(60)
vol=ret.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
lo=cl.rolling(120).min(); hi=cl.rolling(120).max()
pos=(cl-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)
sig=((-r60/(vol+0.05))*(1.0+0.75*(0.5-pos))).shift(1)
# winsorize cross-section per date
sig=sig.clip(-5,5)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
    fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1
    vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
    for dt in sig.index:
        a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
        if ok.sum()>=8:
            vals.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(ok.sum())
    x=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)).dropna()
    rows.append((h,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1), (x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for z in rows: print('H',z[0],'dates',z[1],'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%z[2:])
# coverage and rank turnover
cov=sig.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U)
rank=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'% (cov.mean(),turn))
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
    fwd=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1; xs=[]
    for dt in sig.index[mask]:
        ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
        if ok.sum()>=8: xs.append(sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman'))
    xs=pd.Series(xs).dropna(); print(name,'dates',len(xs),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(xs.mean(),xs.mean()/xs.std(ddof=1), (xs>0).mean()) if len(xs)>1 else 'insufficient')
# save signal artifact for reproducibility
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20331013_range_position_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
ret=cl.pct_change(); r60=cl.pct_change(60); vol=ret.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Longer regime-aware range: emphasize medium-term losers near the bottom of 180d range.
lo=cl.rolling(180).min(); hi=cl.rolling(180).max(); pos=(cl-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)
sig=((-r60/(vol+0.05))*(1.0+0.75*(0.5-pos))).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(a[ok].corr(b[ok],method='spearman')); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); rows.append((h,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for z in rows: print('H',z[0],'dates',z[1],'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%z[2:])
cov=sig.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U); turn=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(); print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(cov.mean(),turn))
fwd=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
 xs=[]
 for dt in sig.index[mask]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: xs.append(sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman'))
 x=pd.Series(xs).dropna(); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()) if len(x)>1 else 'insufficient')
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20331027_adaptive_range_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
ret=cl.pct_change()
r20=cl.pct_change(20); r60=cl.pct_change(60)
v20=ret.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252); v60=ret.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Blend fast and medium standardized reversal, then favor assets near the lower
# portion of their 180-session range. Lag one completed session.
base=(-0.55*r20/(v20+0.05)-0.45*r60/(v60+0.05))
lo=cl.rolling(180).min(); hi=cl.rolling(180).max()
pos=((cl-lo)/(hi-lo).replace(0,np.nan)).clip(0,1)
weight=(1.20-1.0*pos).clip(0.30,1.20)
sig=(base*weight).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=a[ok].corr(b[ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(vals)
 print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%(len(x) and x.mean() or np.nan,len(x)>1 and x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1) or np.nan,len(x) and (x>0).mean() or np.nan,np.mean(ns) if ns else np.nan))
fwd=cl.shift(-40)/cl-1
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
 xs=[]
 for dt in sig.index[mask]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q)
 x=pd.Series(xs)
 print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()) if len(x)>1 else 'insufficient')
coverage=sig.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U)
turn=sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(coverage.mean(),turn))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20331124_multihorizon_range_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
ret=cl.pct_change(); r20=cl.pct_change(20); r60=cl.pct_change(60)
v20=ret.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252); v60=ret.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
lo180=cl.rolling(180).min(); hi180=cl.rolling(180).max(); pos180=((cl-lo180)/(hi180-lo180).replace(0,np.nan)).clip(0,1)
base=(-.55*r20/(v20+.05)-.45*r60/(v60+.05))*(1.20-pos180).clip(.30,1.20)
# Existing long-horizon range-asymmetry component; remove its daily cross-sectional linear component.
lo252=cl.rolling(252).min(); hi252=cl.rolling(252).max(); pos252=((cl-lo252)/(hi252-lo252).replace(0,np.nan)).clip(0,1)
old=(-r60/(v60+.05))*(1.25-1.5*pos252).clip(.25,1.25)
def resid(row,z):
    ok=row.notna()&z.notna()
    out=pd.Series(np.nan,index=row.index)
    if ok.sum()>=8:
        x=z[ok].values; y=row[ok].values
        den=np.sum((x-x.mean())**2)
        beta=np.sum((x-x.mean())*(y-y.mean()))/den if den>1e-12 else 0
        out.loc[ok]=y-(y.mean()+beta*(x-x.mean()))
    return out
sig=pd.DataFrame({dt:resid(base.loc[dt],old.loc[dt]) for dt in cl.index}).T.clip(-5,5).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1), (x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
fwd=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
 xs=[]
 for dt in sig.index[mask]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q)
 x=pd.Series(xs); print(name,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()) if len(x)>1 else 'insufficient')
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).div(len(U)).mean(),sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
out=sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20331208_residual_multihorizon_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
r=cl.pct_change(); r20=cl.pct_change(20); r60=cl.pct_change(60)
v20=r.rolling(20).std()*np.sqrt(252); v60=r.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Trend persistence: medium-term return, volatility-managed and confirmed by
# short-term direction. Lagged one completed session; bounded for robustness.
confirm=np.sign(r20).replace(0,np.nan)
sig=(r60/(v60+0.04)*(0.65+0.35*confirm)).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 fwd=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  a=sig.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=a[ok].corr(b[ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
fwd=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1
for name,mask in [('2027',sig.index.year==2027),('2028-29',sig.index.year.isin([2028,2029])),('2030',sig.index.year==2030),('2031-32',sig.index.year.isin([2031,2032])),('2033YTD',sig.index.year==2033)]:
 xs=[]
 for dt in sig.index[mask]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&fwd.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(fwd.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill()
r=cl.pct_change()
# Residual contrarian signal: asset's 60d return minus contemporaneous equal-weight
# cross-asset benchmark return, volatility scaled and lagged one completed day.
common=r.mean(axis=1)
res=(cl.pct_change(60)-common.rolling(60).sum())
vol=r.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(252)+.04
sig=(-res/vol).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f avgN %.2f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)))
f=cl.shift(-60)/cl-1
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]:
 x=[]
 for dt in sig.index[m]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q):x.append(q)
 x=pd.Series(x); print(n,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340105_crossasset_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
common=r.mean(axis=1); res=cl.pct_change(60)-common.rolling(60).sum(); vol=r.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(252)+.04
sig=(-res/vol).clip(-5,5).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; a=sig.rank(axis=1); b=f.rank(axis=1); ok=a.notna()&b.notna(); n=ok.sum(axis=1)
 am=a.where(ok).mean(axis=1); bm=b.where(ok).mean(axis=1)
 cov=((a-am.values[:,None])*(b-bm.values[:,None])).where(ok).sum(axis=1)
 den=np.sqrt(((a-am.values[:,None])**2).where(ok).sum(axis=1)*((b-bm.values[:,None])**2).where(ok).sum(axis=1))
 x=(cov/den).where(n>=8).dropna(); x=x[mask.loc[x.index]] if mask is not None else x
 return x
for h in [10,20,40,60]:
 x=calc(h);print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()))
for n,m in [('2020-23',cl.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',cl.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',cl.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',cl.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',cl.index.year>=2033)]:
 x=calc(60,m); print(n,'dates',len(x),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean()))
print('coverage %.6f turnover %.6f'%(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340105_crossasset_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Contrarian shock, activated when cross-asset return dispersion is elevated.
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
shock=(-cl.pct_change(20)/(vol+0.05)).clip(-8,8)
disp=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
# lag all inputs; gate is cross-sectional dispersion relative to trailing 120d median
 gate=(disp>disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median()).astype(float)
sig=(shock.mul(gate,axis=0)).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]; ix=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in ix:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(60,m))
print('coverage',sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340330_dispersion_gated_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
shock=(-cl.pct_change(20)/(vol+0.05)).clip(-8,8)
disp=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
# More selective upper-quartile dispersion regime, all inputs lagged one session.
gate=(disp>disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(0.75)).astype(float)
sig=shock.mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]; ix=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in ix:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(60,m))
print('coverage',sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340413_upperdisp_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
ret20=cl.pct_change(20)
# Downside-only standardized shocks: buy assets suffering large negative lagged returns,
# while avoiding positive-return names that can dominate a generic reversal rank.
sig=(-ret20.clip(upper=0)/(vol+0.05)).clip(0,8)
disp=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
gate=(disp>disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.75)).astype(float)
sig=sig.mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,ix=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index if ix is None else sig.index[ix]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(60,m))
print('coverage',sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340427_downside_dispersion_rebound_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Recovery acceleration: a recent rebound is scored only when it follows a materially weak medium-term path.
r20=cl.pct_change(20); r5=cl.pct_change(5)
# positive 5d recovery after 20d loss, normalized by trailing risk; symmetric zero outside setup
sig=(r5.clip(lower=0)*(-r20).clip(lower=0)/(vol+0.05)**2).clip(0,8).shift(1)
# cross-asset stress gate based on breadth of negative 20d returns, lagged with signal
breadth=(r20<0).mean(axis=1)
gate=(breadth>breadth.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.60)).astype(float)
sig=sig.mul(gate,axis=0)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[]; ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(40,m))
print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340511_recovery_acceleration_signal.csv',index=False)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
ret20=cl.pct_change(20)
# Downside-only standardized shocks: buy assets suffering large negative lagged returns,
# while avoiding positive-return names that can dominate a generic reversal rank.
sig=(-ret20.clip(upper=0)/(vol+0.05)).clip(0,8)
disp=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
gate=(disp>disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.75)).astype(float)
sig=sig.mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,ix=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index if ix is None else sig.index[ix]:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(60,m))
print('coverage',sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340427_downside_dispersion_rebound_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Downside-efficiency reversal: oversold 20d path scaled by realized downside risk.
r20=cl.pct_change(20)
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
raw=(-r20)/(down+0.05)
# activate only in broad cross-asset weakness, lag all information one session
breadth=(r20<0).mean(axis=1)
gate=(breadth>breadth.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.60)).astype(float)
sig=raw.mul(gate,axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(40,m))
print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340608_downside_efficiency_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)

# cross-asset stress gate based on breadth of negative 20d returns, lagged with signal
breadth=(r20<0).mean(axis=1)
gate=(breadth>breadth.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.60)).astype(float)
sig=sig.mul(gate,axis=0)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[]; ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))

print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))

"}

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Volatility-adjusted trend persistence: medium-term return scaled by risk, rewarded
# only when daily direction is persistent; all inputs lagged one session.
r60=cl.pct_change(60)
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
persistence=(r>0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()-0.5
raw=(r60/(vol+0.05))*persistence
sig=raw.shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs)
 return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(40,m))
print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340622_voladjusted_trend_persistence_signal.csv',index=False)

D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Downside-efficiency reversal: oversold 20d path scaled by realized downside risk.
r20=cl.pct_change(20)
down=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
raw=(-r20)/(down+0.05)
# activate only in broad cross-asset weakness, lag all information one session
breadth=(r20<0).mean(axis=1)
gate=(breadth>breadth.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.60)).astype(float)
sig=raw.mul(gate,axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[];ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(40,m))
print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'active_date_fraction',float((gate>0).mean()),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340608_downside_efficiency_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Rebound potential: assets with large peak-to-current drawdown, but penalize persistent downside volatility.
# All inputs lagged one completed session.
dd=cl/cl.rolling(60,min_periods=40).max()-1
neg=r.where(r<0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
pos=r.where(r>0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
sig=(-(dd)/(neg+0.05)*(pos+0.05)/(neg+pos+0.10)).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[]; ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index.year>=2033)]: print(n,calc(20,m))
print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340720_drawdown_rebound_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Longer-horizon rebound: lagged 80-session peak drawdown, scaled by 30-session downside intensity and positive participation.
dd=cl/cl.rolling(80,min_periods=50).max()-1
down=(-r.clip(upper=0)).rolling(30,min_periods=15).mean()
up=(r.clip(lower=0)).rolling(30,min_periods=15).mean()
sig=((-dd)/(down+0.001)*(up+0.001)/(down+up+0.002)).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; xs=[]; ns=[]
 dates=sig.index if mask is None else sig.index[mask]
 for dt in dates:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   q=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): xs.append(q); ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(xs); return len(x),float(x.mean()),float(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)),float((x>0).mean()),float(np.mean(ns))
for h in [10,20,40,60,80]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index>=pd.Timestamp('2033-01-01'))]: print(n,calc(60,m))
print('coverage',float(sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15),'turnover',float(sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean()))
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340803_drawdown_rebound_80d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5200) for s in U}
cl=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'] for s,d in D.items() if d is not None}).sort_index().ffill(); r=cl.pct_change()
# Mean-reversion signal: distance below/above trailing 60D range midpoint, scaled by 20D volatility; lag one completed day.
hi=cl.rolling(60,min_periods=45).max(); lo=cl.rolling(60,min_periods=45).min(); mid=(hi+lo)/2
sig=(-(cl/mid-1)/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=14).std()+0.005)).shift(1)
print('period',cl.index.min().date(),cl.index.max().date(),'assets',len(cl.columns))
def calc(h,mask=None):
 f=cl.shift(-h)/cl-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index[mask] if mask is not None else sig.index:
  ok=sig.loc[dt].notna()&f.loc[dt].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:
   z=sig.loc[dt,ok].corr(f.loc[dt,ok],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(z): vals.append(z);ns.append(ok.sum())
 x=pd.Series(vals); return len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1), (x>0).mean(),np.mean(ns)
for h in [10,20,40,60,80]: print('H',h,calc(h))
for n,m in [('2020-23',sig.index.year<=2023),('2024-26',sig.index.year.isin([2024,2025,2026])),('2027-29',sig.index.year.isin([2027,2028,2029])),('2030-32',sig.index.year.isin([2030,2031,2032])),('2033-34',sig.index>=pd.Timestamp('2033-01-01'))]: print(n,calc(60,m))
print('coverage',sig.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/15,'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean())
sig.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().set_axis(['date','symbol','signal'],axis=1).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20341109_range_position_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_index_daily_data(s,days=6000) for s in U}
prices={s:d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float) for s,d in D.items() if d is not None and len(d)>200}
px=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index(); ret=px.pct_change()
# Candidate: recovery-efficiency drawdown reversal, normalized by trailing 20d volatility; lag one day
DD=px/px.rolling(120,min_periods=100).max()-1
path=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=50).sum().abs()/(ret.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=50).sum()+1e-8)
vol=ret.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(-DD*(1-path)/(vol+1e-5)).shift(1)
# forward close-to-close returns
rows=[]
for h in [10,20,40,60,80]:
  fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1
  vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
  for dt in f.index:
    a=f.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
      vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
  x=pd.Series(vals,index=dates).dropna(); ic=x.mean(); sd=x.std(ddof=1); icir=ic/sd*np.sqrt(252) if sd else np.nan
  print(f'H={h} dates={len(x)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} IC={ic:.6f} ICIR={icir:.6f} hit={(x>0).mean():.4f}')
# coverage and rank turnover on common dates
valid=f.notna().sum(axis=1); cov=valid.mean()/len(U)
r=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(r.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)>0.10).mean()
print(f'coverage={cov:.6f} rank_turnover_proxy={turn:.6f} instruments={len(U)}')
# regimes h60
fr=px.shift(-60)/px-1
for name,a,b in [('2020-23','2020','2023'),('2024-26','2024','2026'),('2027-29','2027','2029'),('2030-32','2030','2032'),('2033-34','2033','2034')]:
 vals=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  if not (str(dt)[:4]>=a and str(dt)[:4]<=b): continue
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
 x=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print(f'regime={name} dates={len(x)} IC={x.mean():.6f} ICIR={x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252):.6f}')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=6000) for s in U}
px=pd.DataFrame({s:d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float) for s,d in D.items() if d is not None and len(d)>200}).sort_index()
r=px.pct_change(); bench=r.mean(axis=1)
# Residual reversal: remove each asset's rolling beta to the equal-weight tradable benchmark,
# then fade its 40d cumulative residual move, scaled by residual path volatility. Lag one day.
beta=r.rolling(120,min_periods=80).cov(bench).div(bench.rolling(120,min_periods=80).var(),axis=0)
res=r.sub(beta.mul(bench,axis=0))
resmove=res.rolling(40,min_periods=30).sum()
resvol=res.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()
f=(-resmove/(resvol*np.sqrt(40)+1e-8)).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20350215_residual_reversal_40d_signal.csv',index_label='date')
for h in [10,20,40,60,80]:
 fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(c): vals.append(c); ns.append(len(z))
 x=pd.Series(vals); print(f'H={h} dates={len(x)} avgN={np.mean(ns):.2f} IC={x.mean():.6f} ICIR={x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252):.6f} hit={(x>0).mean():.4f}')
print(f'coverage={f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean()/len(U):.6f} instruments={len(U)}')
# turnover as fraction of names whose rank quartile changes, 10-day sampled
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); ch=(rank.sub(rank.shift(10)).abs()>0.25).mean(axis=1)
print(f'turnover10={ch.mean():.6f}')
fr=px.shift(-40)/px-1
for name,a,b in [('2020-23','2020','2023'),('2024-26','2024','2026'),('2027-29','2027','2029'),('2030-32','2030','2032'),('2033-35','2033','2035')]:
 vals=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  if a<=str(dt)[:4]<=b:
   z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
   if len(z)>=8:
    c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
    if pd.notna(c): vals.append(c)
 x=pd.Series(vals); print(f'regime={name} dates={len(x)} IC={x.mean():.6f} ICIR={x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252):.6f} hit={(x>0).mean():.4f}')

## Explored Factors

1. **Benchmark-Residual Risk-Adjusted Reversal 60D**
   - Estimated each asset’s rolling 120-day beta to the equal-weight return of the 15 tradable instruments.
   - Removed benchmark exposure to obtain residual returns.
   - Faded the 60-day cumulative residual move and scaled by 60-day residual volatility:
     \[
     -\frac{\sum_{k=1}^{60}\text{residual return}_{t-k}}
     {\sqrt{60}\,\sigma_{60}(\text{residual return})+\epsilon}
     \]
   - Signal was lagged by one completed trading day.
   - Validation used only tradable instruments and no observation-only macro series.

## Validation Results

| Horizon | Dates | Average N | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 10D | 2,163 | 14.99 | +0.086480 | +4.821612 | 61.95% |
| 20D | 2,153 | 14.99 | +0.132860 | +7.157140 | 66.42% |
| 40D | 2,133 | 14.99 | +0.186278 | +10.502329 | 75.25% |
| 60D | 2,113 | 14.99 | +0.203164 | +11.957638 | 77.76% |

Additional metrics:

- Coverage: **53.59%**
- Universe: **15 tradable instruments**
- Minimum valid cross-section: **8**
- Average valid cross-section: **14.99**
- 10-day turnover: **11.80%**
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`; deterministic post-Miner audit remains authoritative
- Admission thresholds:
  - Absolute daily paper IC ≥ 0.0070 — **passed**
  - Absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840 — **passed**

### 40D Regime Results

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024–2026 | 44 | +0.231850 | +20.522905 |
| 2027–2029 | 782 | +0.181162 | +9.280521 |
| 2030–2032 | 784 | +0.199637 | +11.211871 |
| 2033–2035 | 523 | +0.170069 | +11.319520 |

The factor maintained positive predictive performance across all evaluated regimes. Results should nevertheless be interpreted conservatively because the cross-section contains only 15 instruments.

- `factors/miner_3_20350301_residual_reversal_60d.json`

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{P}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
 px[s]=d
prices=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); rets=prices.pct_change()
# short shock reversal, risk scaled, computed from information through date t
shock=-(prices/prices.shift(5)-1)
vol=rets.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=shock/(vol+0.005)
# winsorize cross-section each day to limit crypto outliers
f=f.clip(-5,5)
def calc(h):
 vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(prices)-h):
  dt=prices.index[i]; a=f.iloc[i]; y=prices.iloc[i+h]/prices.iloc[i]-1
  z=pd.concat([a,y],axis=1).dropna();
  if len(z)>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
 x=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)); return x,len(ns),np.mean(ns)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',prices.index.min().date(),prices.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 x,n,an=calc(h); print('H',h,'dates',n,'avgN',round(an,2),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
# regimes H10
x,_,_=calc(10)
for a,b in [('2020','2023'),('2024','2026'),('2027','2029'),('2030','2032'),('2033','2035')]:
 q=x[(x.index>=a)&(x.index<=b+'-12-31')]
 if len(q): print('REG',a,b,len(q),round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6))
# coverage and turnover proxy
valid=f.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U); print('coverage',round(valid.mean(),4),'turnover_proxy',round((f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1)).mean(),4))
# artifact
out=f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna(); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20350426_shortshock_volscaled_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P='../persistent/stock_data'
px={s:pd.read_csv(f'{P}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float) for s in U}
prices=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2035-05-09']; r=prices.pct_change()
# Directional path efficiency: net 60D move divided by total absolute daily movement; lag one bar for tradability.
net=prices/prices.shift(60)-1
path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum()
f=(net/(path+1e-8)).shift(1).clip(-1,1)
def calc(h):
 vals=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(prices)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i],prices.iloc[i+h]/prices.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ds.append(prices.index[i]); ns.append(len(z))
 x=pd.Series(vals,index=ds); return x,len(ns),np.mean(ns)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',prices.index.min().date(),prices.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P='../persistent/stock_data'
px={s:pd.read_csv(f'{P}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float) for s in U}
prices=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:'2035-05-09']; r=prices.pct_change()
net=prices/prices.shift(60)-1
path=r.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum()
# Inverse path efficiency reversal, lagged one completed session.
f=(-(net/(path+1e-8))).shift(1).clip(-1,1)
def calc(h):
 vals=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(prices)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i],prices.iloc[i+h]/prices.iloc[i]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ds.append(prices.index[i]); ns.append(len(z))
 x=pd.Series(vals,index=ds); return x,len(ns),np.mean(ns)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',prices.index.min().date(),prices.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 x,n,an=calc(h); print('H',h,'dates',n,'avgN',round(an,2),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
x,_,_=calc(10)
for a,b in [('2020','2023'),('2024','2026'),('2027','2029'),('2030','2032'),('2033','2035')]:
 q=x[(x.index>=a)&(x.index<=b+'-12-31')]
 if len(q): print('REG',a,b,len(q),round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6))
valid=f.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U); print('coverage',round(valid.mean(),4),'turnover_proxy',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
out=f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna(); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20350510_path_efficiency_60d_signal.csv',index=False)

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P='../persistent/stock_data'
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv(f'{P}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
 px[s]=d
prices=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); prices=prices.loc[:'2035-04-25']; rets=prices.pct_change()
# short shock reversal, risk scaled, computed from information through date t
shock=-(prices/prices.shift(5)-1)
vol=rets.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
f=shock/(vol+0.005)
# winsorize cross-section each day to limit crypto outliers
f=f.clip(-5,5)
def calc(h):
 vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(prices)-h):
  dt=prices.index[i]; a=f.iloc[i]; y=prices.iloc[i+h]/prices.iloc[i]-1
  z=pd.concat([a,y],axis=1).dropna();
  if len(z)>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
 x=pd.Series(vals,index=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)); return x,len(ns),np.mean(ns)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',prices.index.min().date(),prices.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20,40,60]:
 x,n,an=calc(h); print('H',h,'dates',n,'avgN',round(an,2),'IC',round(x.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round((x>0).mean(),4))
# regimes H10
x,_,_=calc(10)
for a,b in [('2020','2023'),('2024','2026'),('2027','2029'),('2030','2032'),('2033','2035')]:
 q=x[(x.index>=a)&(x.index<=b+'-12-31')]
 if len(q): print('REG',a,b,len(q),round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6))
# coverage and turnover proxy
valid=f.notna().sum(axis=1)/len(U); print('coverage',round(valid.mean(),4),'turnover_proxy',round((f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1)).mean(),4))
# artifact
out=f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal').dropna(); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20350426_shortshock_volscaled_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
"}
